{{Top|leg}}
'''Arkanian diamonds''' were a type of [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkania]]. They could be cut to form lenses for [[Arkanian-diamond goggles|goggles]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>, seemingly indestructible [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] alloys, and jewels. The [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian's]] [[mutant]] [[Accelerated Transgenic Heuristic Abhorer]]s were capable of reducing Arkanian diamonds to chyme with their powerful digestive systems. The [[Clone template/Legends|prime clone]] of the Abhorers [[Zeta Magnus]] was known to dine on raw meat with [[Deltron spice wine]] and a side of Arkanian diamonds.<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>
